T.topic_fa: دیور و پرادا، کریسمس ۲۰۲۶: پرادا با مداد کشید و تشویق شد؛ فیلم دیور را استادِ انیمیشن دستی ساخت، ولی به‌خاطر یک دستِ شش‌انگشتی متهم شد که کارِ هوش مصنوعی است
T.topic_en: Prada drew its Christmas film by hand and got applause. Dior hired a master of hand-drawn animation and got accused of AI over a six-fingered hand
T.central_tension_fa: فکر می‌کنیم کارِ واقعی خودش دیده می‌شود؛ ولی در فیدی پر از هوش مصنوعی، حتی کارِ دستیِ یک استاد هم مشکوک است. حالا لوکس‌ترین چیز در تبلیغ، اثباتِ این است که آدم ساختش: پرادا مداد را نشان داد، دیور مجبور شد توضیح بدهد.
T.central_tension_en: We assume real craft speaks for itself. In a feed full of AI, even a master's hand-drawn work looks suspect. The most luxurious thing an ad can show now is proof a human made it: Prada showed the pencil, Dior had to explain the fingers.
T.working_hook_fa: دیور استادِ انیمیشن دستی را استخدام کرد. اینترنت گفت: «این هوش مصنوعی است.» مشکل یک انگشت بود.
T.working_hook_en: Dior hired a master of hand-drawn animation. The internet counted six fingers and called it AI.

cover_idea.object: wooden artist's hand mannequin (monochrome) with a pencil

key_sources.claim: Dior 'Night in Color' by Sylvain Chomet; viewers flag warped lettering, lazy eye, misplaced finger bone; Jonathan Anderson to WWD: 'all hand-drawn using techniques that go back to the 1940s'

Chomet: ~20 artists, seven months; 'automated interpolation' for 'a very small part'; 'You might see six or seven fingers because you're trying to convey movement'; voices incl. Rihanna, Robert Pattinson
Dior ad seen as the opposite of Prada's; X post 4 Nov 'am i the only one noticing this is ai?'
'Luxury urged to prove its craftsmanship'; Chomet on Dior Instagram: 'we work just like in the 1940s'
'Drawing Prada: Animated By Hand', led by John Pomeroy; every frame hand-drawn over live action; Pomeroy: 'I learnt my craft with pencil and paper'
'As AI slop floods feeds, luxury brands are going all in on handmade ads'; ex-Disney animator Pomeroy
15,000 IG/TikTok comments: Prada sentiment 93/100, Dior 82; few AI-suspicion comments on Dior but high engagement; a hand-drawn-animation comment drew 1,709 likes

T.framing_note: Type 1. Spine: (1) same Christmas, two luxury houses, both choose animation; (2) Prada: an ex-Disney animator, pencil on paper, applause ('anti-AI-slop'); (3) Dior: Sylvain Chomet, a famous hand-drawn director, star voices, seven months... and viewers count six fingers; (4) the denial: 'techniques from the 1940s', 'fingers blur because they move', but a small automated step is admitted; (5) the turn: proof is the new luxury - Prada showed its pencil, Dior had to explain itself; (6) lesson: don't just make it by hand, show the hands (process, sketches, names). One number on screen: 6 (fingers). NEVER state Dior used AI: accusation vs denial only. Do not use Ben Wild's LinkedIn claim or the 'Dior deleted comments' allegation (unverified). Do not name private individuals who posted. No AI-generated imitations of either film, characters, Dior/Prada logos, or Rihanna/Pattinson likeness; real frames only from owner uploads, framed and credited ('Dior', 'Prada'). No photos of real actors' faces. Caption: sources + 'editorial use; images belong to their owners'. Never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate.
